== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* After joining [[Galatasaray Esports]] he dyed his hair red and yellow, the colors of the organization.
* Temporarily retired from professional play in 2020 after allegedly going unpaid by both [[Galatasaray Esports]] and [[Redemption eSports Porto Alegre|Redemption eSports]].
** For more on his alleged non-payment by Galatasaray, which affected multiple players, see [[Galatasaray 2019 Payment Controversy]]
